question: How does sitting quietly and taking slow, deep breaths in Yoga make our mind feel? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! Deep breathing exercises in Yoga help us relax and make our minds feel completely calm and peaceful! 😌
hint: It is a very nice and relaxing feeling.

question: What is the best time of day to practice our Yoga poses? 🌅
explanation: Great job! Early morning is the best time for Yoga because the air is fresh and quiet. ☀️
hint: It is when the sun just wakes up.

question: Which body part must we try to keep very straight while sitting in a Yoga pose? 🧘‍♂️
explanation: Super! Keeping our back and spine straight helps us breathe better and stay healthy! 척
hint: It runs down the middle of your body behind you.

question: What is the simple name for the special deep breathing we do in Yoga? 🌬️
explanation: Fantastic! Pranayama is the special Yoga word for controlling our breath to feel good. 🧘‍♀️
hint: It starts with the letter P.

question: What should we sit on when we practice our Yoga on the floor? 🟩
explanation: Awesome! A clean, soft Yoga mat keeps our body safe and comfortable while we practice. 🟩
hint: It is a soft rectangle you roll out on the floor.

question: When we breathe in very slowly, what are we taking into our body? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! Breathing in fills our lungs with fresh, clean air to give us energy! 🍃
hint: It is all around us and keeps us alive.

question: How should our eyes be when we are doing a quiet breathing exercise? 😌
explanation: Super! Gently closing our eyes helps us block out noise and focus on our breath. 😌
hint: It is how your eyes look when you are resting.

question: Where should we place our hands when sitting in a cross-legged Yoga pose? ✋
explanation: Awesome! Resting our hands gently on our knees helps us sit still and feel balanced. 🧘
hint: They rest on the middle bend of your legs.

question: Yoga does not just help our mind! It also makes our body very... 💪
explanation: Great job! Stretching in Yoga makes our muscles strong and our body easy to move! 🤸
hint: It means you can bend easily and lift things.

question: What is the famous cross-legged sitting pose in Yoga called? 🌸
explanation: Super! Padmasana, or the Lotus pose, is a beautiful way to sit still and steady. 🌸
hint: It is named after a beautiful pink flower that floats on water.

question: How fast should we breathe when we want to calm down? 🐢
explanation: Awesome! Slow and steady breathing tells our brain that it is time to relax. 🐢
hint: Think of how a turtle walks.

question: What kind of place is best to practice Yoga in? 🏡
explanation: Great job! A clean and quiet space helps our mind stay peaceful while we practice. 🏡
hint: It is a place where you will not be disturbed.

question: Before starting Yoga in the morning, our stomach should ideally be... 🥣
explanation: Super! Doing Yoga on an empty or very light stomach keeps us from feeling sick when we bend. 🍃
hint: It means you have not eaten a big meal yet.

question: When we concentrate in Yoga, we train our brain to focus on... 🎯
explanation: Awesome! Concentration means keeping our mind focused on just one thing, like our breath! 🎯
hint: It is like aiming at the bullseye on a target.

question: If we practice Yoga every day, how will we feel at school? 🎒
explanation: Great job! Yoga gives us great energy and makes our brain super sharp for learning! 🧠
hint: You will feel ready to smile and learn.

question: What happens to our muscles when we do simple Yoga stretches? 🤸‍♀️
explanation: Super! Stretching out our body takes away the tightness and makes our muscles feel relaxed! 😌
hint: They feel loose and happy.

question: If you feel angry because you lost a game, what Yoga trick can help? 😤
explanation: Awesome! Whenever you feel mad, stopping to take deep breaths blows the anger away! 🌬️
hint: It involves taking air in and out slowly.

question: What kind of clothes are best to wear while doing Yoga? 👕
explanation: Great job! Loose and stretchy clothes let our arms and legs bend and move freely! 👕
hint: These are clothes you can easily play and run in.

question: Through which part of our body should we usually breathe in during Yoga? 👃
explanation: Super! Breathing through our nose filters the air and warms it up before it goes inside! 👃
hint: It is right in the middle of your face.

question: Taking a deep breath in feels just like... 🌺
explanation: Awesome! A slow, deep breath in is exactly like smelling a beautiful, sweet flower! 🌺
hint: Think of a beautiful pink rose.

question: Letting a deep breath out slowly feels just like... 🎂
explanation: Great job! Breathing out slowly is like gently blowing the air onto birthday candles! 🎂
hint: You do this on your birthday cake.

question: Yoga teaches us to sit very still. What else is very still? 🌳
explanation: Super! Just like a strong tree with deep roots, we sit perfectly still and steady! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and brown bark.

question: What do we call the shape we make with our body in Yoga? 🧘
explanation: Awesome! The special shapes and ways we sit or stand in Yoga are called poses or Asanas! 🧘
hint: It rhymes with 'rose'.

question: How should your neck feel when you sit for breathing exercises? 🦒
explanation: Great job! Keeping your neck straight helps your head stay balanced without hurting. 🦒
hint: It should be tall like a giraffe but comfortable.

question: What should we do if our mind starts thinking about toys during Yoga? 🧸
explanation: Super! It is okay if the mind wanders. We just gently bring our focus back to our breathing! 🧘
hint: Gently remind your brain to think about breathing again.

question: Where does the fresh air go when we take a very big breath? 🫁
explanation: Awesome! Our lungs are like two big balloons inside our chest that fill up with air! 🫁
hint: They are inside your chest and act like balloons.

question: Yoga is for our body and our mind. They work together like a... 🤝
explanation: Great job! Yoga connects our mind and body so they can work together like best friends! 🤝
hint: They help each other out.

question: How should your shoulders be when you sit for Yoga? 🔽
explanation: Super! Dropping our shoulders away from our ears makes us feel much more relaxed! 🔽
hint: Let them fall away from your ears.

question: Can children practice Yoga just like grown-ups do? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Awesome! Yoga is wonderful because kids, parents, and grandparents can all do it! ✅
hint: It is an activity for the whole family.

question: When we finish our Yoga practice, what should we say? 🙏
explanation: Great job! Ending Yoga by feeling thankful brings a big happy smile to our hearts! 🙏
hint: It is a polite two-word phrase.

question: What is the very first step before sitting down for Yoga? 🧼
explanation: Super! Being clean and fresh helps us feel ready and respectful for our Yoga practice! 🧼
hint: It involves soap and water.

question: What happens to our heart beat when we take slow deep breaths? ❤️
explanation: Awesome! Deep breathing sends a message to our heart to beat at a calm, relaxed pace! 🐢
hint: It matches the speed of a resting turtle.

question: Which of these is a great place to sit and do breathing exercises? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Being near nature and trees gives us peace and lots of fresh oxygen! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and gives nice shade.

question: How should our face look while we are practicing Yoga? 😊
explanation: Super! A gentle smile relaxes all the tiny muscles in our face and makes us feel happy! 😊
hint: It is the expression you make when you see a friend.

question: What do we use to listen to the sound of our own breath? 👂
explanation: Awesome! We can actually use our ears to listen quietly as the air goes in and out! 👂
hint: They are on the sides of your head.

question: Doing Yoga is a very healthy daily... 📅
explanation: Great job! Brushing our teeth and doing Yoga are both wonderful daily healthy habits! 📅
hint: It is something good that you do every single day.

question: What sound can we hum gently to calm our mind even more? 🕉️
explanation: Super! Humming a gentle 'Om' sound creates peaceful vibrations in our head and chest! 🕉️
hint: It is a special, peaceful Yoga word.

question: Why do we sit with our legs crossed in the simple Yoga pose? 🧘‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Crossing our legs creates a wide base so we sit super steady like a mountain! ⚓
hint: It keeps us from wobbling around.

question: When we focus carefully in Yoga, it helps us do better at... 📚
explanation: Great job! A focused mind makes it so much easier to read, write, and finish homework! 📚
hint: It is the work your teacher gives you.

question: Which word best describes how Yoga should feel? ✨
explanation: Super! Yoga is meant to be a quiet, joyful, and deeply peaceful time for yourself. ✨
hint: It means quiet and calm.

question: What should we do before rolling out our Yoga mat? 🧹
explanation: Awesome! A clean floor makes our Yoga space feel nice, fresh, and ready for practice! 🧹
hint: You use a broom to do this.

question: If a Yoga pose feels hard to do, what should you do? 🛑
explanation: Great job! In Yoga, we never push too hard. We just rest and try again nicely tomorrow! 🛑
hint: Take a small break and relax.

question: What is the name for practicing Yoga in the morning? 🌄
explanation: Super! Morning practice wakes up our body and gets us ready for a fantastic day! 🌄
hint: It happens right after you wake up.

question: Breathing in Yoga is like a wave in the... 🌊
explanation: Awesome! Our slow breath goes in and out just like smooth, gentle waves in the ocean! 🌊
hint: It is a huge body of blue water.

question: How long should we try to sit perfectly still at first? ⏱️
explanation: Great job! Even just sitting still for a few short minutes makes a big difference! ⏱️
hint: It is a short amount of time, like 2 or 3.

question: Yoga helps us learn to be very... 🕊️
explanation: Super! When we are calm inside, it is easy to be patient and kind to our friends! 🕊️
hint: It means waiting nicely and being good.

question: If you feel nervous before a spelling test, Yoga helps you feel... 🦸
explanation: Awesome! Taking a deep breath blows away the nervous feelings and makes you brave! 🦸
hint: It is how a superhero feels.

question: In the Lotus pose, our folded legs look like the petals of a... 🪷
explanation: Great job! Padmasana gets its name because our crossed legs look like a beautiful Lotus! 🪷
hint: It is a pink flower that sits on ponds.

question: Yoga teaches us to love and care for our... ❤️
explanation: Super! Doing Yoga is the best way to say 'I love you' to our own mind and body! ❤️
hint: It is yourself, inside and outside.

question: Yoga is a wonderful tool we can use for our whole... 🌍
explanation: Awesome! The Yoga tools we learn now will help us stay healthy and happy our whole life! 🌍
hint: It means all the years you will live.
